actual_doc94.title: # Sequential gate v2: prospective power feasibility

required_before_inference: Exact public calibration item fixture and expected receipt/matching criterion. Existing five-call latency calibration is not substituted.

proposed_study.controls_hard_gate: Promotion also requires candidate correct count >= each control in every observed stratum, strictly greater overall than both controls, and zero candidate domain violations. Counts assessed only on shared completed observations; no control-driven early prefix veto.
proposed_study.acceptance: Signed gatev3 promote_proposal plus both control gates; control failure retain_incumbent; scientific cap/futility insufficient_power; infrastructure or missing prerequisites candidate_requires_review. No automatic signing/retention.
proposed_study.source_hashing: Once per study execution before inference, not per item; independent fresh-process replay verifies frozen source/journal without network.
proposed_study.admission_status: DRAFT ONLY: calibration, executable harness, complete source pins, schedule and exclusive reserve allocation must be bound before first inference call.
